args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation plans for June 10th - June 20th, 2024

- Swimwear (2-3 suits)
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Hiking gear (hiking boots, poles, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight pants, t-shirts, shorts)
- Camera (waterproof case recommended)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, insurance card)
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Luau attire (traditional Hawaiian shirt, flower garland)
- Kayaking gear (life jacket, paddle)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Power adapter (Hawaii uses Type A and B plugs)
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Water shoes
- First aid kit
- Prescription medications
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel-sized essentials (toothbrush, toothpaste, shampoo, conditioner)
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmation
- Flight itinerary
- Hawaii driver's license

Created from the vacation plans document for Emma Johnson's Hawaii trip.
